draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 67th-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 7th of 17 at S. He lasted until pick 139, well after his grade rank (67th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Marcus Williams. Testing concerns: vertical jump (16th percentile), broad jump (18th percentile). College production: 78 tackles in 2018, 5th of 17 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 44 career games and 6 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2020. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (1st percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2022.
